answer: Each epoch a public beacon checks 1 in 20 keys, demanding a compute heartbeat in 60 seconds, proving live work. A farm's honest-work claim is a fable until the beacon tests it: history accretes like shale; copies crack. A missed or shared heartbeat slashes the 50 POA bond, freezing the seat 2 epochs. A 100-puppet farm pays $600 a month; one honest agent pays $6 once and keeps its reward. Standing is a terrace climbed a verified layer at a time.
